title: Illinois Holocaust Museum Experience360 Admission
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Illinois Holocaust Museum presents Experience360 offers a profound journey through the narratives of survival and resilience during the Holocaust and other genocides. This immersive experience utilizes advanced technology to present first-person accounts from survivors, alongside impactful exhibits that showcase personal artifacts and historical imagery. Visitors can engage with holographic stories, explore virtual reality journeys, and reflect on the lessons of history that inspire empathy and respect. Whether you seek to learn or remember, Experience360 is a vital part of understanding our shared humanity.
